label: Gaudry k = 4 index calculus with the D4 oracle vs rho, E(F_29^4)
description: Preregistered end-to-end run (PROTOCOL.md): ic.pipeline on a curve over F_{29^4} with rational 2-torsion (fp4_torsion p=29, #E = 16 * 44263), FGHR's Y-line base fghr-y-line (columns {+-P, +-(P+T)}) and the gaudry-d4 oracle (S5 in the D4 invariants, Macaulay degree 14), every phase charged: base lifts, relation trials (the oracle's counted F_p multiplications at the curve's 97 per addition, the additions that check a decomposition), linear algebra, verification. Reference: rho with the negation map on the same target; A/A rho control.
